crew_github_app_app_identity: Row label: the bot identity the crew commits with
crew_github_app_app_installations: Row label: where the app is installed
crew_github_app_app_name: Row label: the GitHub App's name
crew_github_app_app_owner: Row label: the account that owns the app
crew_github_app_app_permissions: Row label: the permissions the app has
crew_github_app_converting: Status while the crew server exchanges the code for the app's credentials
crew_github_app_create: Button that starts creating the GitHub App
crew_github_app_create_hint: Hint under the create button; the quoted button is GitHub's own English label
crew_github_app_deadline: Countdown while waiting for GitHub; {time} is minutes and seconds
crew_github_app_deadline_note: Note about the 1 hour life of GitHub's manifest code
crew_github_app_group_title: Title of the GitHub group of one crew server in Settings > Atlas Crew; {server} is the server's name
crew_github_app_install: Button that opens GitHub's install page for the app
crew_github_app_installations_error: Shown when the crew server could not list the installations; {detail} is its text
crew_github_app_installing: Status while polling for the installation
crew_github_app_intro: Intro of the GitHub App card; {server} is the crew server's name
crew_github_app_load_failed: Shown when the status call failed; {detail} is the error
crew_github_app_loading: Shown while the crew server is asked for the app
crew_github_app_manage: Button that opens GitHub's install page to change the repositories
crew_github_app_not_installed: Shown when the app has no installation
crew_github_app_org_invalid: Hint under the organization field when the login does not look like a GitHub login
crew_github_app_org_label: Label of the field for the organization's GitHub login
crew_github_app_owner_label: Label of the owner choice (my account or an organization)
crew_github_app_owner_user: Owner choice: the user's own GitHub account
crew_github_app_preparing: Create button label while the browser page is being prepared
crew_github_app_refresh: Button that asks the crew server for the app's status again
crew_github_app_refreshing: Refresh button label while it runs
crew_github_app_remove_description: Body of the confirmation to remove the app
crew_github_app_remove_title: Title of the confirmation to remove the app from the crew server
crew_github_app_selection_all: Installation scope: every repository of the account
crew_github_app_simple_description: Description of the row that keeps the gh login option
crew_github_app_simple_title: Title of the row that keeps the gh login option
crew_github_app_timed_out: Error when the browser never came back
crew_github_app_title: Heading of the card that creates the crew server's GitHub App
crew_github_app_waiting_body: Body while the user confirms the app in the browser
crew_github_app_waiting_title: Heading while the user confirms the app in the browser
crew_github_app_workflows_label: Label of the switch that adds GitHub's Workflows permission
crew_github_app_workflows_reason: Why the Workflows permission is opt-in
